query_sampling: 1000 hash-ranked corpus papers (seed 43); no parameter was tuned on them

known_item_search.task: query = the paper's title only; the single relevant document = that paper

category_agreement_at_10.task: query = title + abstract; share of the 10 nearest other papers with the same primary category
category_agreement_at_10.note: A proxy for topical relevance only: neighbours from another category can still be relevant.

index.weighting: sublinear TF x IDF over the whole corpus, L2-normalised (dot product = cosine)
